summary: Moved all access checks into docshelf/access.py and gave each command module a RULES value matching its former behavior; existing tests pass and tests/test_access.py was added. No original copy was kept, so equivalence was checked by reading the old code, not by running both versions side by side. Quirks kept as they were: for example share and delete ignore delegations and treat any suspended account as suspended, and edit lets an account work again on the suspended_until day itself.
